meta.name: tfx-wt
meta.description: Windows Terminal 탭/패인 자연어 조작. 사용자가 "새 탭 열어줘", "패인 분할", "탭 목록", "탭 닫아" 같은 한국어/영어 표현을 쓰면 wt-cli.mjs 경유로 wt-manager API 호출. safety-guard가 wt.exe 직접 호출을 차단하므로 이 스킬이 유일한 경로다. Use when: 새 탭, tab open, 패인, pane split, 탭 목록, 탭 닫아, wt 탭, wt 패인

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 说出日常指令,管理 Windows Terminal 的标签与分屏
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常在 Windows Terminal 里被标签和分屏操作打断思路。
copy.tagline_en: Control Windows Terminal tabs and panes by saying everyday commands.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often lose momentum switching or splitting terminal tabs manually.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能听懂你对 Windows Terminal 标签页/窗格的中文、韩语或英语指令，自动调用脚本执行新建标签、拆分窗格、列出、关闭、重命名等操作，并返回结果。此功能仅在 Windows 上生效。
howto.when: 当你说出“新建标签”、“拆分窗格”、“列出标签”等关键词，或使用对应韩语/英语表达（如“새 탭 열어줘”、“tab open”），且你的系统是 Windows 时触发。

say.text: 新建一个标签页，标题叫 backend，运行 npm run dev
say.note: 会创建一个新标签并执行该命令

say.text: 把当前窗格左右拆分成两个，左边显示日志

say.note: 返回标签标题和 ID 列表

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude understands Chinese, Korean, or English requests about Windows Terminal tabs/panes and calls a script to create tabs, split panes, list, close, or rename them, returning results. Windows only.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'new tab', 'split pane', 'list tabs', or their Korean/English equivalents (e.g., '새 탭 열어줘', 'tab open'), and you are on Windows.

say_en.text: Open a new tab titled backend and run npm run dev
say_en.note: Creates a tab and runs the command

say_en.text: Split the current pane horizontally, show logs on the right
say_en.note: Splits pane in the given direction
